description: Retro evidence guardrails. The retro of the Effect benchmark and the DoD run found four process defects:

userStories.title: Council searches prior decisions
userStories.description: As an advisor, I want `/council` to find prior ADR and RFC issues so that a council does not miss an earlier decision.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/skills/council/SKILL.md` § 2 holds a step before dispatch: the advisor runs `gh issue list --state all --search "ADR: in:title"` and `--search "RFC: in:title"` in each repository in scope.
The step puts each matching issue number and state into the shared brief as a constraint or as prior context.
`bash .agro/skills/ste/scripts/ste-check.sh .agro/skills/council/SKILL.md` reports no new finding on the changed lines.
userStories.notes: executed: council § 2 new step 6 runs gh issue list -R <owner>/<repo> --state all for ADR: and RFC: titles in each repository in scope and puts number and state into the shared brief (repair round 1 added -R); ste-check same single pre-existing finding; link check 0.

userStories.title: Close maps each criterion to literal evidence
userStories.description: As an advisor, I want Close to match each criterion to its evidence so that no report claims an uncovered criterion.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/skills/delegate/SKILL.md` § Close holds a step before `## Lessons`. The advisor lists each task-level criterion with its evidence. The evidence must match the exact subject that the criterion names, for example a job type, a command, or a file.
The step marks a criterion `unmet` when the evidence covers a different subject, and the advisor does not report the task as done.
`bash .agro/skills/ste/scripts/ste-check.sh .agro/skills/delegate/SKILL.md` reports no new finding on the changed lines.
userStories.notes: executed: delegate § Close new step 2 lists each task-level criterion with evidence matching its exact subject, marks mismatches unmet, and forbids reporting done; ste-check same 3 pre-existing findings; link check 0; reasoned: next.sh reads only the Lessons section, no external Close step references.

userStories.title: Plans name criterion owners and protect comparison metrics
userStories.description: As an advisor, I want criteria to name their owner and comparison plans to protect their metrics so that the result stays true.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/skills/prd/SKILL.md` § Acceptance criteria holds an owner rule. A criterion that another agent or the operator controls carries the label `external`. The advisor tracks an `external` criterion, and that criterion does not block Close.

`.agro/skills/prd/SKILL.md` holds a comparison rule for a plan that compares implementation variants. A fresh critic reviews the metrics file before any variant code exists. Each compared site has at least two variants. Changed-line metrics count production lines and test lines separately.
`bash .agro/skills/ste/scripts/ste-check.sh .agro/skills/prd/SKILL.md` reports no new finding on the changed lines.
userStories.notes: executed: prd § Acceptance criteria adds the external owner rule and the comparison rule (fresh critic before variant code, two variants per site, production and test lines counted separately); ste-check same 6 pre-existing findings, none on changed lines; link check 0.

userStories.title: Changelog and manual review evidence
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want a changelog entry and a command transcript so that I can confirm the skill changes without a rerun.
acceptanceCriteria: `CHANGELOG.md` holds one entry under `## [Unreleased]` that names the four rules and links the task issue.
`.agro/tasks/retro-evidence-guardrails/evidence/manual-review.md` holds the commands and exit codes of `bash .agro/scripts/link-providers.sh --check`, `pnpm test`, and the three `ste-check.sh` runs.
userStories.notes: executed: CHANGELOG Unreleased Changed entry names the four rules and links #1576; evidence/manual-review.md holds link check, pnpm test (14 baseline host failures), three ste-check runs with pre-existing findings on unchanged lines; advisor: ste-check on evidence exit 0, link check exit 0.
